Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: raw source for a project-local riso print
Primary request: Create a brand-new, original illustration of three small survey crews aligning three mirrored prism tripods along a steep unfinished concrete accessibility ramp.
Scene/backdrop: An abstract construction site with no identifiable landmark.
Subject: Exactly three separate mirrored prism tripods, plain marker flags, a few coiled cables, and an unfinished concrete ramp; three small crews are distributed along the ramp and remain small relative to the structure. Use simple solid-color workwear without reflective bands, stripes, checks, or other patterns. Prism equipment must be plain mirrored circular or faceted forms without target-board graphics.
Style/medium: Tactile architectural material collage with rough concrete, textile flags, metal, broad irregular pigment patches, and hand-cut paper edges; an original visual language.
Composition/framing: 2:3 portrait orientation, low side view. Equipment and ramp fill the frame, with a strong central silhouette and angular clusters.
Color palette: Safety orange, signal violet, deep construction ink, and warm paper.
Constraints: No text, no logos, no watermark. Absolutely no stripes, bands, checks, grids, target-board patterns, or animal patterns on any surface, garment, or object. No pyramids, desert, or mountains. No copied composition. Do not include extra narrative objects.
